hey everybody just a quick short today so I did 
a series on optimizing the origin companions

for balers Gate 3 already watch the first one 
here I will link to both of those in the video

description as well but ever since I did those 
videos I've been getting flooded with requests

to optimize the non-origin companions as well 
jira Minsk hon manthara here's the thing I

kind of feel like I've already done builds that 
are perfect for those characters conceptually

schematically I just put them in other videos 
and didn't call them optimized builds for the

companions right so if you want to see how 
I would optimize those non-origin companions

here are the builds I would use for Menara our 
favorite evil Paladin I would use the crit Lander

build from my third bg3 builds video for hon I'd 
go with the ultimate tank build from that very

first bg3 build video for jira I'd use either the 
spores Druid eldrich Knight build that I did from

my most recent bg3 video or the blender build 
from my second balers Gate 3 video that was a

ranger not a druid but I I think it works well 
for her still thematically as for Minsk I know

he's technically supposed to be a ranger but 
no way Minsk was a character used in baldder

gate 2 that game came out before barbarians 
existed as their own class anyway in DN D it

was D in the second edition Minsk is a barbarian 
he can speak to hamsters sure so he's a wildart

barbarian use the non bear tank build from that 
second bg3 video or if you want to give him some

additional offensive power go with the Holy 
Warrior build from that first video replacing

Berserker with wildart for the Barbarian subass 
and I would use oath of the ancients for the

Paladin subass that's the one that has a little 
more nature Affinity right this Minsk protects

his Boo by smiting his enemies into Oblivion 
all of those videos are linked in the video

description and I think all of these builds do a 
great job of both being super powerful but also

really on point for these companion characters 
conceptually staying true to their main class or

at least the way the characters personality 
seem to want to be expressed in game enjoy
